blurb: Caledonia Brewing is a small batch craft brewery located in the historic 1924 Dunedin Times building. They focus on natural and organic ingredients and serve their own craft beers along with local guest taps. The taproom features a large open space with community tables, a covered pet friendly outdoor patio, and a bike rack.
